title_en: Penthouse for sale 3+1+2 in the center (ID B130103) Tirana.
description_en: In the Center, Zogu i Pare Boulevard, near Tirana Bank, 3+1 penthouse for sale with a separate kitchen, 2 bathrooms, total area 230 m2, net area 203 m2, of which 161 m2 is internal area and 42 m2 veranda area, 12th floor, new building with elevator, functional fireplace, wardrobe, laundry, parquet, air conditioner in every room, laid with quality parquet, sold furnished.
